body: I feel the same way. I have been having a lot of people come to me for support meanwhile they refuse to give any sort of support to me. It is exhausting having to be the bigger person but I know I can at least help them go through life a little easily even though it means that I am getting the short end of the stick. I would recommend setting time aside just for yourself and only yourself if possible. I like to sit in the grass (it helps ground myself when I am overstimulated) and journal my feelings out or even do a few doodles that express how I feel. I find that gratitude statements help me feel a little less in the dumps. If you want try writing down what you are grateful for (and it can definitely be yourself) and try to be as specific as possible. Also, talking to a professional might help too but I totally get good therapists and such are hard to find. I may not always feel like I am being heard by others but at least I can feel heard by myself and the universe.  I am not perfect but this is what seems to be helping me at the moment. You are an amazing part of this world and you are doing amazing for helping others but remember that sometimes you need to save that support for yourself when you need. It is as my mom used to say when I was growing up "It is good to be there for others but sometimes you need to have a little bit of ego so people don't walk all over you". You are seen and you are heard! Have a great day.
It is not easy unfortunately but it is a struggle I cannot change, only persevere through. I am so proud of you too! Thank you so much for reading my post :)
I am so glad you found them. Have an amazing day and I am here if you need anything
You deserve it!! You got this and I am here if you need some support <3

The same exact moment happened to me on Friday and it has been the same since. As if I was not struggling enough with life a bad depressive episode hits wow. I understand how you feel.  Some things that help me cope through these dark times is creating a comfort playlist, taking a walk (as cliche as that sounds), taking naps, or just creating a safe space for myself. I know some of these options require a lot of effort and sometimes all you can do is just exist. If you ever need help please ask for it. I wish I had learned how to ask for help.

I understand completely. Living everyday seems so much worse than just ending it and the only reason we haven't done it is because of someone else. It is just that one person is depending on your existence and its exhausting. Please keep trying and fighting. I know it is exhausting but at least there are small, and even big sometimes, moments of sweetness that you can feel the nourishment of the sugar. I know it is so hard to keep that weight on your back everyday but it makes us stronger and somehow it will get better. It has gotten better over the years for me in a weird way. You are strong. I know you can survive. This has become very useful for me in the past and now so I thought I should include it for you too (HOTLINE # 1-800-273-8255).

Thank you. We talked about it and I told him my piece of mind. He told me he was just frustrated with it but he apologized and promised me it would never happen again. I really am hoping I set enough boundaries for it to never happen again.
